compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md exists emitting JSON conforming to schema at plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json with SC-1 fields: bbox_confidence (anchored|inferred), dom_xpath, dom_xpath_visually_consistent, attribution_class, attribution_confidence, and scores for 5 dimensions
- dd-2: Agent prompt includes per-integer anchor text for all 5 dimensions (5x5=25 anchors total) and the attribution decision tree
- dd-3: Agent file contains ≥3 few-shot examples per attribution_class (≥12 total) in a reviewable table including mobile+desktop contrastive pairs

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md as a self-contained agent prompt. Required sections:

1. YAML frontmatter: name, description, model, allowed-tools
2. JSON output contract referencing plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json fields
3. Per-integer anchor table — 5 dimensions × 5 integers = 25 rows total:
   Dimensions: whitespace_balance, element_density, visual_hierarchy_legibility, alignment_grid_adherence, intent_match
   Each dimension needs anchors for 1 (worst) through 5 (best)
4. Attribution decision tree — explicit conditional logic:
   - implementation_drift: spec contradicts render
   - design_flaw: render matches spec but spec is deficient
   - mixed: both (1) and (2) simultaneously with distinct evidence
   - uncertain: spec absent/ambiguous
5. Few-shot example table — ≥12 examples, ≥3 per attribution_class, ≥1 mobile+desktop contrastive pair per class
6. Reference to params: "Parameters imported from plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml"

Create tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent_structure.py to structurally verify the .md content:
- test_25_rubric_anchors: count anchor table rows = 25
- test_attribution_decision_tree: verify all 4 attribution_class values named in decision tree section
- test_few_shot_coverage: count ≥12 few-shot table rows, ≥3 per class, ≥1 mobile+desktop pair
- Update .test-index with entries for visual-evaluator.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Agent file exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md
- [ ] Agent references all 6 SC-1 schema fields by name
  Verify: python3 -c 'p=open("plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md").read(); assert all(f in p for f in ["bbox_confidence","dom_xpath","dom_xpath_visually_consistent","attribution_class","attribution_confidence","scores"])'
- [ ] Agent contains exactly 25 rubric anchor rows (5 dimensions × integers 1-5)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent_structure.py::test_25_rubric_anchors -v
- [ ] Agent contains attribution decision tree covering all 4 classes
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent_structure.py::test_attribution_decision_tree -v
- [ ] Agent contains ≥12 few-shot examples with ≥3 per attribution_class and ≥1 mobile+desktop contrastive pair
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_agent_structure.py::test_few_shot_coverage -v
- [ ] Agent references visual-evaluator-params.yaml
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator-params.yaml' plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md
- [ ] .test-index entries added for visual-evaluator.md
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator.md' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
